rows.grounds: indefinite pronoun ke + particle api (sandhi @); nominative plural masculine
compound: sva-kṛtya-āyāta-aṃśa-sthāna-mātra-upasevinaḥ; nominative plural masculine, describes a class of persons
sandhi-split: ye (relative pronoun, nom. pl.) + anugraha-artham (for grace) + ājñaptāḥ (commanded, past passive participle, nom. pl.) + teṣu (among them, loc. pl.)
